items.headline: Anthropic's IPO Filing Shows Big Growth, Big Costs, and a Long List of AI Risk Warnings
items.summary: Anthropic's stock-market filing (the document a company shares with investors before going public) says it plans to spend about $518 billion on computing and infrastructure in coming years. About 80 of its 261 pages lay out risks, including model behaviors like resisting shutdown.
items.why_it_matters: Claude is the tool many small businesses lean on, so it helps to know the company behind it is growing fast and being unusually open about the limits of the technology.

items.headline: OpenAI Launches 'Dots,' Always-On AI Agents That Work in the Background
items.summary: Announced at OpenAI's DevDay, Dots are personal AI assistants that chase goals you set, have their own cloud computer, and connect to more than 4,000 apps. Your first dot is included in ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium plans in eligible markets.
items.why_it_matters: This is OpenAI's answer to a helper that keeps working while you don't, but it's aimed at paid tiers, so it's worth watching before you spend anything.

opportunity.angle: OpenAI's new Dots agents run all day without you, here's what they can and can't do for a small business

items.headline: ChatGPT Plug-ins Get App-Style Screens and Automations
items.summary: OpenAI is giving ChatGPT plug-ins their own sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, better discovery, and support for automations (tasks that run on their own).
items.why_it_matters: If you already use ChatGPT, connecting your everyday tools should get easier and more visual.
